2) If the dates look tight, suggest alternatives and mark priority level
3) I can schedule a 30-min alignment session with your team and Evelyn next week to lock the kickoff.

Attached: Clearline_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP), clearline-eval-playbook.xlsx (detailed checklist).
